title: Joshua 19
paragraphs: ¹ The second lot fell to the tribe of Simeon, for their clans. Their territory lay within the territory of Judah. ² Their allotment included Beersheba, Sheba, and Moladah, ³ Hazar-shual, Balah, and Ezem, ⁴ Eltolad, Bethul, and Hormah, ⁵ Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susah,

⁶ Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen — thirteen cities with their villages. ⁷ Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan — four cities with their villages. ⁸ And all the settlements around these cities as far as Baalath-beer (Ramah of the Negev). This was the inheritance of the tribe of Simeon by their clans. ⁹ The Simeonites received their portion from the territory of Judah, because Judah's share was more than they needed. So Simeon received their inheritance within Judah's territory. ¹⁰ The third lot came up for the tribe of Zebulun by their clans. The boundary of their territory reached to Sarid.

¹¹ Their border went westward to Maralah, touching Dabbesheth and the stream east of Jokneam. ¹² From Sarid it turned east toward the sunrise to the boundary of Chisloth-tabor, then continued to Daberath and up to Japhia. ¹³ From there it continued east to Gath-hepher and Eth-kazin, extending to Rimmon and bending toward Neah. ¹⁴ The border swung around on the north side to Hannathon, and its limit was the valley of Iphtah-el. ¹⁵ Also included were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem — twelve cities with their villages.

¹⁶ This was the inheritance of the tribe of Zebulun by their clans — these cities with their villages. ¹⁷ The fourth lot came out for the tribe of Issachar by their clans. ¹⁸ Their territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, and Shunem, ¹⁹ Hapharaim, Shion, and Anaharath, ²⁰ Rabbith, Kishion, and Ebez,

²¹ Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, and Beth-pazzez. ²² The boundary touched Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, ending at the Jordan — sixteen cities with their villages. ²³ This was the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar by their clans — the cities with their villages. ²⁴ The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher by their clans. ²⁵ Their territory included Helkath, Hali, Beten, and Achshaph,

²⁶ Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal. The boundary reached westward to Carmel and Shihor-libnath, ²⁷ then turned east toward Beth-dagon, touching Zebulun and the valley of Iphtah-el northward, then Beth-emek and Neiel, and extended to Cabul on the left, ²⁸ Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, and Kanah, as far as Greater Sidon. ²⁹ The border turned back toward Ramah and to the fortified city of Tyre, then curved to Hosah, ending at the sea near Achzib. ³⁰ Also Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob — twenty-two cities with their villages.

³¹ This was the inheritance of the tribe of Asher by their clans — these cities with their villages. ³² The sixth lot came out for the tribe of Naphtali by their clans. ³³ Their border ran from Heleph, from the oak at Zaanannim, through Adami-nekeb and Jabneel as far as Lakkum, ending at the Jordan. ³⁴ The boundary then turned west to Aznoth-tabor, went out from there to Hukkok, and touched Zebulun on the south, Asher on the west, and Judah at the Jordan toward the sunrise. ³⁵ The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth,

³⁶ Adamah, Ramah, and Hazor, ³⁷ Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor, ³⁸ Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh — nineteen cities with their villages. ³⁹ This was the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali by their clans — the cities with their villages. ⁴⁰ The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan by their clans.

⁴¹ The territory of their inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, and Ir-shemesh, ⁴² Shaalabbin, Aijalon, and Ithlah, ⁴³ Elon, Timnah, and Ekron, ⁴⁴ Eltekeh, Gibbethon, and Baalath, ⁴⁵ Jehud, Bene-berak, and Gath-rimmon,

⁴⁶ Me-jarkon and Rakkon, with the territory facing Joppa. ⁴⁷ But the territory of the Danites was too small for them, so the Danites marched up and attacked Leshem, captured it, put it to the sword, and took possession of it. They settled there and renamed it Dan, after their ancestor. ⁴⁸ This was the inheritance of the tribe of Dan by their clans — these cities with their villages. ⁴⁹ When they had finished dividing up the land by its boundaries, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them. ⁵⁰ In keeping with the LORD's command, they gave him the town he asked for — Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim. He built up the town and settled there.

⁵¹ These are the inheritances that Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the tribal families of Israel distributed by lot at Shiloh before the LORD, at the entrance to the tent of meeting. And they finished dividing up the land.
